comment: Source roots and durable-artifact roots are declared separately: source roots are
enumerated from an explicit NUL-delimited tracked-file listing (git ls-files -z),
while artifact roots are walked on the filesystem because durable run output is
deliberately untracked. Sealed source snapshots inside artifact roots are detected
structurally (a nested checkout marker) and excluded, because they are verbatim
copies of scanned source and would manufacture false consumers.
'root' entries beginning with './' are resolved against --library-root.

corpora.name: rlrmp2
corpora.restatement_reason: ci/*.toml are allowlists that restate this repository's own surface as data in order to declare a rule about it. They are evidence of a policy, not an independent dependency on a guaranteed interface.

corpora.name: rlrmp
corpora.restatement_reason: ci/feedbax-public-imports.toml is an import allowlist: it names this library's public symbols as data in order to declare a rule about importing them. It is evidence of a policy, not an independent dependency. The rest of ci/ is ordinary configuration and is scanned normally.

corpora.name: feedbax-fixtures
corpora.comment: This library's own durable fixture data: saved documents that would have to migrate or be re-authored if a guarantee changed. Deliberately excludes the library source, which defines the guarantees rather than depending on them.
corpora.restatement_reason: docs/ restates the guaranteed inventory verbatim; it declares the guarantee rather than depending on it.

corpora.name: feedbax-tests
corpora.comment: This library's own tests, scripts, and examples. Their dependence on a guarantee is expected and does not by itself argue that anything outside the library needs it; it is reported separately so the two are never conflated.
corpora.restatement_reason: docs/ and the agent instruction files restate the policy; they declare the guarantee rather than depending on it.

control_corpus.name: controls
control_corpus.restatement_reason: Negative control: an import-allowlist restatement that must never be counted as a dependency.
